{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''coded virus''' that erased all clues of its presence in a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] systems was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Taking of Kuat]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus was installed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Event Horizon (battlecruiser)|''Event Horizon'']] and four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], and caused them to fire upon the other Imperial warships with their [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] during the battle.
